sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw) and sit top with 22 points from 10 matches, while Alsager Town arrive in poor form with just one win from their last six and occupy the relegation zone with only 4 points.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town, seeking to keep pace with leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. Title contenders AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth place, with AFC Bridgnorth aiming to bounce back from their most recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter, while other fixtures see Foley Meir host struggling Bilston Town, Market Drayton Town visit New Mills (both chasing points in the lower half), Crewe face Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town (two of the division's poorest performers), Shawbury United host Barnton, and Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, the division's bottom side with just 2 points.
